rule: Hard LIVE (merge/ledger/lru/topo/intervals) fails when the 4B model loops on read_file until max_steps. Teacher fix: give tools the model can call. read_file is numbered. edit_lines replaces a line span. bug_comments surfaces BUG/FIXME markers already in the fixture source. After 3 observe tools the runtime injects STOP observing / MUST mutate. Do not raise max_steps. Do not farm greeter. Do not put hard LIVE into eligible until a scored PASS lands. Sequence: bug_comments -> numbered read tests+source once -> edit_lines/apply_patch -> run_tests.

example_fix.bug: merge live 10x read_file zero writes max_steps
example_fix.observed: tool_order observe-loop; apply_patch unused; write_file too large for 512 tokens
example_fix.hypothesis: C+D — missing line-edit tool and observe-loop breaker, not budget
fix: keep merge on SEED_DENY until live PASS
